visual_action: The video features an interview with an elderly Black veteran who discusses the struggles of former soldiers. His interview is intercut with various B-roll shots, including archival-style war footage, a man raising an American flag, exterior shots of a U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs building and a VA Medical Center. It also includes news clips from FOX News, one showing Donald Trump in the Oval Office with a chyron about cutting jobs at Veterans Affairs, and another showing veterans protesting with signs. The video concludes with shots of the veteran at a war memorial, where he salutes and then walks away with a cane.

cast.name: Unnamed veteran
cast.evidence: This elderly Black man is the sole speaker in the video, sharing his perspective as a veteran. He is shown wearing a hat that says 'VIETNAM VETERAN'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is named in the opening on-screen text, 'WATCH: Veteran attacks Trump for leaving former soldiers behind,' and in a news chyron that reads 'TRUMP ADMIN. PLANS TO CUT 80K EMPLOYEES FROM VETERANS AFFAIRS.' He is also briefly shown sitting at a desk in the Oval Office.

cast.name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
cast.evidence: The organization is referenced in a news chyron about budget cuts and its buildings are shown. A protest sign reads 'Don't cut V.A. SERVICES'.

cast.name: FOX News
cast.evidence: The news organization's logo appears on screen during the clips used as B-roll.

on_screen_text.text: WATCH: Veteran attacks Trump for leaving former soldiers behind
WHAT REALLY HURTS THE MOST IS WHEN
TRUMP ADMIN. PLANS TO CUT 80K EMPLOYEES FROM VETERANS AFFAIRS
IF ONE VETERAN IS HURT, ALL ARE HURT
IF ONE VETERAN IS HOMELESS, WE ALL ARE HOMELESS
IF ONE VETERAN IS NOT BEING TREATED RIGHT,
THEN WE ALL ARE NOT BEING TREATED RIGHT.

spoken_summary: An unnamed veteran states that "war is hell" and expresses pain over soldiers dying for a country that doesn't seem to care for them emotionally afterward. He says he has noticed fewer services for veterans in medicine, healthcare, and housing. He concludes by emphasizing veteran solidarity, stating, "If one veteran is hurt, all are hurt. If one veteran is homeless, we all are homeless. If one veteran is not being treated right, then we all are not being treated right."
audio_music: A slow, somber piano-based instrumental track plays continuously under the veteran's spoken testimony, creating a serious and emotional mood.
editing_pacing: The video primarily consists of a talking-head interview with the veteran, intercut with illustrative B-roll footage including archival war scenes, news clips, and shots of the veteran at a memorial. The pacing is moderate, with cuts timed to the speaker's narrative.
central_claim: The Trump administration neglected veterans by cutting essential services like healthcare and housing.
intended_effect: To evoke sympathy for veterans and anger toward Donald Trump for his administration's alleged policies.
